[profile.release]
opt-level = "z"     # Optimize for size
lto = "fat"         # Aggressive Link Time Optimization
strip = "symbols"   # Strip debug symbols from the SHIPPED binary (kept small)
codegen-units = 1   # Reduce parallel codegen for better optimization
panic = "abort"     # Don't unwind on panic, saves space (panic hook runs first)
overflow-checks = false  # Disable overflow checks for size
# Keep local debug information separate from the shipped executable.
debug = 1           # line tables (enough for symbolication)
split-debuginfo = "packed"
debug-assertions = false  # No debug assertions
incremental = false # Disable incremental compilation for release
rpath = false       # Don't include rpath
